checks.proves: The package has complete current coverage, valid unit/task/check linkage and no unresolved template markers under the repository validator.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove product/runtime correctness or that BB has not moved since the command began.
checks.passCriteria: Command exits zero on the package bookkeeping candidate.
checks.failCriteria: Any schema, coverage, unit, task, marker or readiness validation error is reported.

checks.command: git status --short && git diff --name-status HEAD^ HEAD
checks.proves: Makes local dirt and the exact U001 bookkeeping commit inventory reviewable before later product work.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not independently determine semantic relevance of each future product path.
checks.passCriteria: U001 commit contains only this existing Captain package, and unrelated local work remains unstaged/unmodified.
checks.failCriteria: Any product/runtime file or another planning package enters the U001 commit, or unrelated dirty work is overwritten.
